milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a jungle_log block drops a jungle_log item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so any jungle_log present confirms successful mining. Note: the task says 'jungle_wood' but the actual item ID dropped from jungle_log blocks is 'jungle_log'.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden_pickaxe ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no items, so the presence of a wooden_pickaxe definitively proves the multi-step crafting chain (jungle_log → jungle_planks → sticks + planks → wooden_pickaxe) was completed at the crafting table.
